governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with the team’s organisational, workforce and professional-practice arrangements governed through the relevant Digital and IT forums.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the team’s remit, staffing and capacity; the revised Year One role mix; whether solution architecture is covered within the senior engineering role or separately; recruitment route and timing; product ownership and delivery coordination; use and funding of agentic software-development tooling; demand intake and prioritisation; reuse or retirement of relevant KAI technical assets; the evidence the first year must generate about team shape and institutional capability; any material increase in the first-year Hub scope that would compete with the King’s Edge roadmap; product and delivery practices; interfaces with specialist Digital and IT functions; evidence-based decisions to expand the team; handover criteria and enduring institutional ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – Digital and IT product development capability owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: The capability is expected to sit within Digital and IT. Education secures mobilisation investment, while Digital and IT creates and recruits the technical roles through its workforce processes. Digital and IT has indicated a preference for permanent roles where possible because this improves recruitment and reflects the likely enduring need for the capability; the strategic funding route must therefore distinguish establishment funding from recurrent business-as-usual cost rather than assume fixed-term posts by default. The enduring organisational home, recurrent staffing, professional leadership and relationship to the Digital Student Experience Hub product and platform ownership under 4.1.2 should be confirmed as the operating model is proven. During 2026/27, the revised four-person core and one shared pipeline are the planning baseline. King’s Edge remains the principal substantive product demand and the September 2027 Hub is a focused first live release. Any material expansion in integration depth, team size or agentic tooling should follow evidence from delivery and live use.
